tools.name: pretrade_check
tools.description: Is this Solana token safe to buy? Rug check this mint before a swap. Should my agent trade this token? Quick SAFE / CAUTION / BLOCK verdict with reasons and a priority-fee estimate. Price $0.01 per call via x402 (USDC on Solana or Base); 10 free calls per IP per day. When payment is needed the tool returns x402 payment instructions instead of data. Not financial advice.
